blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–The Philippines is aiming to improve on its medal haul at the 5th Asian Para Games in Japan despite the absence of chess, which accounted for eight of the country’s 10 gold medals in the 2023 edition in Hangzhou. Philippine Paralympic Committee president Mike Barredo said he remains confident in the 69-athlete delegation competing in Nagoya from October 18 to 24.
